objective: From the merged PR #259 baseline, implement a deep MoveIt/controller module that accepts only a closed pose goal, plans only, exposes only AcceptedTrajectory, materializes an immutable integer-nanosecond controller-facing snapshot, and proves zero C3a execution goals.
decision_supported: Freeze the C3a plan-only seam and prevent C3a from becoming an execution, semantic-action, or dynamic-scene task.
forbidden: ros2_control controller goal or topic dispatch
SemanticAction, ActionResult, EvidenceSink, or WorldState writes
second trajectory validator, clamp, reorder, or repair
outputs: deep plan-only bridge interface and implementation with internal planning/readiness seams
bounded plan-only launch harness, sample-level RMW provenance collector, and machine-readable probe evidence
C3a README handoff and zero-dispatch evidence
sanitized, checksummed v6 acceptance evidence under docs/evidence/motion-260-c3a-plan-only/v6
acceptance: The implementation baseline contains PR #259 merge commit 4f892a7fe12a1474fd0e6c77205d862bef095856 and AcceptedTrajectory is the only trajectory exposed at the controller seam

The external interface accepts only a closed pose/frame/tolerance goal; arm identity, MoveIt constraints, and start state are constructed internally from controlled config/readiness, with generic MoveIt messages, JointConstraint, caller start state, raw joint fields, unknown fields, and caller execution/action-server controls rejected
PlanOnlyResult never exposes the raw MoveIt candidate trajectory and preserves MoveIt/preflight source reason codes on failure
MoveIt MotionPlanRequest uses arm.yaml identity, the fresh readiness start state, PlanningOptions.plan_only=true, and replan=false; the result trajectory_start must match that start state

The C3a MoveGroup launch fixes allow_trajectory_execution=false and disables move_group/MoveGroupExecuteTrajectoryAction without a caller override; the MoveGroup action endpoint is fixed at /move_action, and no C3a ExecuteTrajectory, FollowJointTrajectory, controller-topic, or gripper client is created or sent

Materialization revalidates accepted canonical bytes and hashes, preserves exact joint order and integer-nanosecond timestamps in a deeply immutable non-ROS snapshot, and rejects current context/config mismatch
Missing, incomplete, clock-incomparable, or stale joint-state/TF/controller-configuration readiness, non-empty multi-DOF trajectory, and hash mismatch fail closed with stable diagnostic codes

After the probe proves execution is disabled, a create-only request marker arms the provenance collector; the collector records its own marker observation time, discards joint-state and dynamic-TF samples whose DDS receive timestamps are not newer than that time, uses the next fresh samples for readiness, and removes the marker on success or failure

Clock proof evidence includes the canonical controlled publisher graph/use_sim_time proof and its independently reproducible hash plus the actual rmw_message_info publisher GID and middleware source/receive timestamps of each joint-state and TF sample used by readiness; each actual writer GID must match the collector callback-time endpoint and remain present in the probe's graph proof
Planning server unavailable, planning timeout, MoveIt rejection, adapter error, normal, boundary, malicious-bypass, and wrong-type tests pass through the public C3a interface

Versioned canonical planning-request, readiness, and config hashes cover the expanded robot description, arm/SRDF/kinematics/OMPL/MoveIt-limits/controller/preflight inputs and relevant ROS/MoveIt package versions without redefining #57 trajectory/context hashes

A bounded launch harness starts execution-disabled MoveGroup, runs one probe, confirms MoveGroup and both support-process exits before publishing evidence, shuts down without residual ROS processes, reports C3a execution_goal_count=0, and never publishes a Gazebo or physical success claim
C3b sampled collision gating and C3c dynamic scene lifecycle remain separate follow-up work
commands: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && colcon --log-base /tmp/workbench-c3a-colcon-log build --base-paths robot/control/workbench_motion robot/control/workbench_motion_provenance --build-base /tmp/workbench-c3a-build --install-base install --packages-select workbench_motion_provenance workbench_motion --cmake-args -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch workbench_motion c3a_plan_only.launch.py evidence_path:=/tmp/c3a-plan-only.json
evidence: Motion focused tests and root required-check output
ROS build and bounded execution-disabled MoveGroup plan-only harness output
allow_trajectory_execution=false, C3a execution_goal_count=0, no residual ROS process, and stable diagnostic/source-reason evidence
baseline and C3a commits, versioned planning/readiness/config component hashes, ROS/package versions, and truthful git_dirty status
stop_conditions: the implementation baseline does not contain PR #259 merge commit 4f892a7fe12a1474fd0e6c77205d862bef095856 or its AcceptedTrajectory interface changes incompatibly
implementation requires public schema/model, service, firmware, robot-description, or WorldState changes
any C3a execution interface/goal/raw controller path, caller-controlled execute/action-server/start-state field, or raw joint constraint appears
C3a would duplicate #57 validation or add dynamic scene/semantic-action behavior
zero-dispatch evidence or clean-worktree evidence cannot be produced
data_classification: repository-local planning and test evidence only
model_policy: AI assistance is authorized only for this packet's repository-local allowed paths; the implemented code and tests must not call an external model, upload repository data, use a runtime cloud dependency, or perform physical execution.
risks_and_fallbacks: C3a zero-dispatch evidence is scoped to the C3a module, adapters, and dedicated launch; it does not claim that the isolated Phase-2 diagnostic probe or arbitrary same-domain ROS nodes lack execution capability
C3a validates controller configuration identity only; active controller readiness and ROS-domain isolation remain C3b or later integration/security work
If the bounded ROS harness cannot start, finish, write complete evidence, and shut down deterministically, record NOT_EXECUTED and stop instead of substituting fake or unit-test evidence
Linux/Integration review is required before merging move_group launch, package.xml, setup.py, ROS dependency, or acceptance-harness changes
